purpose: Pre-run protocol for a bounded, non-statistical withheld-path-diagnostics parity comparison.

baseline_binary.verification: An isolated release build from git archive 58ca2a671f33eb329ff3249d6859d86625ba0495 produced the same SHA-256.

panel.policy: All nine jobs use this single pinned panel byte sequence.

common_invocation.prewarm: Read and validate exactly the first 1,000,000 FASTQ records before each timed command; prewarm duration is excluded from wall-time reporting.

comparison_contract.product_contract: Ordered FASTA records, complete headers, sequence bytes, and sequence SHA-256 values must be equal across each sample's three roles.
comparison_contract.diagnostic_contract: Aggregate threshold diagnostics must be equal after removal only of the explicitly preregistered opt-in payload key. Unknown changed fields fail comparison.
comparison_contract.timing_contract: One balanced trio per sample yields descriptive wall time and maximum RSS only; it is not statistical evidence or a global performance claim.
comparison_contract.read_support_limit: Absence in a capped 1M-record collection does not establish absence of a graph path or biological sequence.

focused_diagnostic_only.comparison: Each focused changed_on run is diagnostic-only and is compared with its full-panel changed_on counterpart for the selected targets' ordered products, existing aggregate diagnostics, and five count fields. Focused wall time/RSS are not aggregate parity metrics.

synthetic_and_control_parity_plan: Run Sol/Astra-approved focused diagnostics unit tests before real comparisons.
Flag-off behavior must preserve existing synthetic exact-product, withheld-repeat, count, and aggregate diagnostic results.
Flag-on behavior must preserve the same products and counts while adding only the approved diagnostic payload for withheld-path controls.
No synthetic result is used to infer recovery correctness or sample haplotype truth from the real capped inputs.
